select max(tqr.SCHEDULE_DATE) as scheduleDate, max(tqr.BATCH_NO) as tqBatchNo, ci.BEAD_CODE as steelRingCode, max(ci.BEAD_TYPE) as steelType, max(ci.BEAD_ARRANGE) as `rank`, max(ci.DIMENSION) as dimension, max(ci.PRO_SIZE) as proSize, 1 as unitConsume, /* 胎圈1班消耗量 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass1Plan, /* 胎圈2班消耗量 = 钢丝圈1班需求 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass2Plan, /* 胎圈3班消耗量 = 钢丝圈2班需求 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass3Plan, /* 胎圈4班消耗量 = 钢丝圈3班需求 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass4Plan, /* 胎圈5班消耗量 = 钢丝圈4班需求 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass5Plan, /* 胎圈6班消耗量 = 钢丝圈5班需求 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS6_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as tqClass6Plan, max(tqr.CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG) as closeOutSpecFlag, /* 上一天胎圈夜班（昨日2班）剩余库存来源 */ IFNULL(sum(prevTqr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY), 0) as lastMidPlanQty, /* 钢丝圈1班计划量初始值 = 胎圈2班消耗量 */ sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as class1PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as class2PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as class3PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as class4PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS6_PLAN_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as class5PlanQty, 0 as class6PlanQty from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT tqr inner join ( SELECT TIRE_RING_CODE, MAX(BEAD_CODE) BEAD_CODE, MAX(BEAD_ARRANGE) BEAD_ARRANGE, MAX(BEAD_TYPE) BEAD_TYPE, MAX(Dimension) DIMENSION, MAX(PRO_SIZE) PRO_SIZE, MAX(IFNULL(BOM_QTY, 1)) BOM_QTY FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
GROUP BY TIRE_RING_CODE ) ci on tqr.BEAD_CODE = ci.TIRE_RING_CODE left join ( SELECT BEAD_CODE, IFNULL(sum(CLASS2_PLAN_QTY), 0) CLASS2_PLAN_QTY FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY BEAD_CODE ) prevTqr ON prevTqr.BEAD_CODE = tqr.BEAD_CODE where tqr.SCHEDULE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and tqr.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.BEAD_CODE having sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(tqr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(tqr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(tqr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(tqr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(tqr.CLASS6_PLAN_QTY, 0)) > 0

select ci.BEAD_CODE STEEL_RING_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT concat(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,'$',cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,'$',cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION) order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION SEPARATOR ',') as quotaKeys from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
group by ci.BEAD_CODE

( #{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.tqBatchNo}, #{item.batchNo}, #{item.orderNo}, #{item.steelType}, #{item.steelRingCode}, #{item.twiningDiscCode}, #{item.proSize}, #{item.rank}, #{item.dimension}, #{item.machineCode}, #{item.unitConsume}, #{item.stockQty}, #{item.supplyTime}, #{item.class1Sequence}, #{item.class1PlanQty}, #{item.class1Analysis}, #{item.class2Sequence}, #{item.class2PlanQty}, #{item.class2Analysis}, #{item.class3Sequence}, #{item.class3PlanQty}, #{item.class3Analysis}, #{item.class4Sequence}, #{item.class4PlanQty}, #{item.class4Analysis}, #{item.class5Sequence}, #{item.class5PlanQty}, #{item.class5Analysis}, #{item.class6Sequence}, #{item.class6PlanQty}, #{item.class6Analysis}, #{item.tqClass1Plan}, #{item.tqClass2Plan}, #{item.tqClass3Plan}, #{item.tqClass4Plan}, #{item.tqClass5Plan}, #{item.tqClass6Plan}, #{item.isRelease}, #{item.markCloseOutTip}, #{item.productionStatus}, #{item.closeOutSpecFlag}, #{item.unscheduledFlag}, #{item.freshExpiredFlag}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.explainJson}, 0, #{item.createBy}, now() )

mapper.select: select PARAM_CODE paramCode, PARAM_NAME paramName, PARAM_VALUE paramValue, REGULAR_EXPRESSION regularExpression, ERROR_TIPS errorTips from T_GSQ_PARAMS where IS_DELETE = 0
select max(BATCH_NO) from T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where SCHEDULE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

select ci.BEAD_CODE as steelRingCode, max(ci.BEAD_TYPE) as steelType, max(ci.BEAD_ARRANGE) as `rank`, 1 as unitConsume, max(ci.DIMENSION) as dimension, max(ci.PRO_SIZE) as proSize, max(IFNULL(ci.BOM_QTY, 1)) as bomQty, max(ci.WIRE_DIAMETER) as wireDiameter, null as tireRingCodeList, null as embryoCodeList, null as cxClass1Plan, null as cxClass2Plan, null as cxClass3Plan, null as cxClass4Plan, null as cxClass5Plan, null as quotaKeys from T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci where ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and ci.BEAD_CODE in
#{code}
group by ci.BEAD_CODE
select * from T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where SCHEDULE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DEL_FLAG = 0

mapper.select:
select ci.BEAD_CODE as beadCode, ci.BEAD_TYPE as beadType, ci.BEAD_ARRANGE as beadArrange, ci.TIRE_RING_CODE as tireRingCode, ci.EMBRYO_CODE as embryoCode, ci.EMBRYO_VERSION as bomDataVersion, ci.DIMENSION as dimension, ci.PRO_SIZE as proSize, ci.WIRE_DIAMETER as wireDiameter from T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci inner join ( select distinct BEAD_CODE from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where SCHEDULE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DEL_FLAG = 0 ) tqr on ci.BEAD_CODE = tqr.BEAD_CODE where ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
select SPEC_CODE from T_GSQ_ASSIST_SPEC where DEL_FLAG = '0'

select tqr.BEAD_CODE as beadCode, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class1PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class2PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class3PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class4PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class5PlanQty, sum(IFNULL(tqr.CLASS6_PLAN_QTY, 0)) as class6PlanQty from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT tqr where tqr.SCHEDULE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and tqr.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by tqr.BEAD_CODE

select SHIFT_DATE as shiftDate, SHIFT_CODE as shiftCode, STOP_FLAG as stopFlag from T_TQ_STOP_SHIFT_CONFIG where SHIFT_DATE between DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL -1 DAY) and DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and DEL_FLAG = 0

select SHIFT_DATE as shiftDate, SHIFT_CODE as shiftCode, STOP_FLAG as stopFlag from T_GSQ_STOP_SHIFT_CONFIG where SHIFT_DATE between DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL -1 DAY) and DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and DEL_FLAG = 0

select MACHINE_CODE as machineCode, MAINTENANCE_DATE as maintenanceDate, SHIFT_CODE as shiftCode from T_GSQ_MACHINE_MAINTENANCE_PLAN where MAINTENANCE_DATE between STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DEL_FLAG = 0
